available.quote: Subject to Subsections (4) through (7), the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a)the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b)the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c)the applicant's license is in good standing
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 302

requirements.value: License by endorsement available if: (1) similar scope of practice, (2) at least one year of experience under the out-of-state license, and (3) license in good standing in the other state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a building inspector beyond the scope of the license held.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hiring or employing an unlicensed person as a building inspector, unless exempt from licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: hiring or employing in any manner an unlicensed person as a building inspector, unless exempt from licensure under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: As a building official, directing or knowingly allowing an inspector to perform beyond the scope of the inspector's license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: as a building official, directing or knowingly allowing an employed or contracted inspector to perform beyond the scope of the inspector's license held under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to inspect or issue correction notices for code violations constituting a hazard to public health and safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly failing to inspect or issue correction notices for code violations that when left uncorrected would constitute a hazard to the public health and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to require compliance with correction notices.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly failing to require compliance with correction notices

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of alcohol or illegal drugs while performing duties to the extent of physical or mental impairment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the use of alcohol or the illegal use of drugs while performing duties to the extent that the inspector is physically or mentally impaired and unable to effectively perform the duties of an inspector

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the performance of official duties as an inspector.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross negligence in the performance of official duties as an inspector

disciplinary_grounds.description: Personal use or unauthorized disclosure of information obtained as a result of the inspector's employment or position.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the personal use of information or knowingly revealing information to unauthorized persons when that information has been obtained by an inspector as a result of the inspector's employment, work, or position as an inspector

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawful acts or practices that are clearly unethical under generally recognized standards of conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unlawful acts or practices that are clearly unethical under generally recognized standards of conduct of an inspector

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fraud or knowingly misrepresenting a fact relating to the performance of duties and responsibilities.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in fraud or knowingly misrepresenting a fact relating to the performance of duties and responsibilities as an inspector

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to require that plans, specifications, and documents be stamped by architects or professional engineers as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a building inspector knowingly failing to require that all plans, specifications, drawings, documents, and reports be stamped by architects, professional engineers, or both as established by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to report to the division an act or omission of a construction trades licensee that constitutes a hazard to public health and safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a building inspector knowingly failing to report to the division an act or omission of a licensee under Chapter 55, Utah Construction Trades Licensing Act, which when left uncorrected constitutes a hazard to public health and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to report to the division unlicensed persons who are required to be licensed under the Construction Trades Licensing Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: an inspector knowingly failing to report to the division unlicensed practice persons who are required to be licensed under Chapter 55, Utah Construction Trades Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Approving work that materially varies from stamped approved documents without authorization from the licensed professional.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a building inspector's approval of work that materially varies from approved documents that have been stamped by an architect, professional engineer, or both unless authorized by the licensed architect, professional engineer, or both

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to produce verification of current licensure and certifications upon request.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a building inspector failing to produce verification of current licensure and current certifications for the codes upon request of the division, a compliance agency, or a contractor or property owner whose work is being inspected

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requiring work that materially varies from the codes adopted by the state, including amendments.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a building inspector requiring work that materially varies from the codes adopted by the state, including amendments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make reasonable efforts to maintain current knowledge of code amendments.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: an inspector failing to make reasonable efforts to maintain a current knowledge of amendments to code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying inspection reports or purporting to perform an inspection that was not actually performed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsifying inspection reports or purporting to perform an inspection that was not actually performed as an inspector

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in retaliatory actions against individuals or companies that file complaints or question the local regulator's decisions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: an inspector engaging in retaliatory actions against individuals or companies that file complaints or question the local regulator's decisions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting what would reasonably be viewed as a bribe, including monetary, goods, materials, or other benefits in the course of duty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: an inspector accepting what would reasonably be viewed as a bribe, including monetary, goods, materials, or other benefits in the course of duty

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by or at an inspector's direction that causes material injury to another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by an inspector, caused by an inspector, or at an inspector's direction that causes material injury to another

decertification_authority.quote: In accordance with Section 58-1-401, the division may: (a)refuse to issue a license to an applicant; (b)refuse to renew the license of a licensee; (c)revoke, suspend, restrict, or place on probation the license of a licensee; (d)issue a public or private reprimand; (e)issue a citation to a licensee; and (f)issue a cease and desist order.
decertification_authority.citation: Section 9 - Qualifications of inspectors -- Contract for inspection services.

enforcement_delivery_options.quote: A local regulator, state regulator, or compliance agency may contract for the services of a building inspector not regularly employed by the regulator or agency.
